caption: The drawing features a single teapot depicted in a realistic style using black and gray pencil or ink on an off-white background. The teapot, centrally positioned, has a rounded, textured body covered in evenly spaced bumps, a prominent curved spout on the left, and a large, thick, arched handle attached at the top. The lid of the teapot is circular and fits snugly, with a small knob handle in the center. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, simplified technical outline of the same teapot, showing a side view with a measurement scale labeled in inches beneath it. The name "MILDRED FORD" is written in uppercase letters at the top left corner of the drawing inside the border. The primary shading and detailing render the main teapot three-dimensional, emphasizing its form and surface texture. The overall composition is enclosed within a single-line rectangular border.
title: Tea Kettle
